metadata.title: Reflections on Point-Image Phase Synchronization with Commander Sol: Exact Costs, Cut-Space Packings, and a Sharp Stabilization Threshold in FCOA
metadata.description: We study the minimum number L_q(r) of exact same-source point-image constraints pi_i(a)=pi_j(a) needed to force r arbitrary permutations in S_q to be diagonal. In the Fixed-Carrier Oriented Algebra (FCOA) setting, this is the full-support anonymous phase-synchronization cost. We prove an exact reduction to unique q-colorability of a canonical transversal quotient, derive pair-union connectivity, determine L_2(r), L_3(r), L_q(2), L_q(3), and the complete four-phase column L_q(4), and introduce binary cut spaces W(P_a) over F_2^{r-1}. Their pairwise trivial intersection yields the packing inequality sum_a(2^{d_a}-1) <= 2^{r-1}-1. A matching binary-cut construction proves the exact stabilization law L_q(r)=(r-1)q-(2^{r-1}-1) for every q >= 2^{r-1}-1, and proves that this threshold is exact. The article follows FCOA Definition 1.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22164246.
metadata.notes: Bilingual publication package: English and Russian manuscripts, DOCX/PDF/HTML/LaTeX exports, theorem provenance, finite verification scripts and logs, SHA-256 manifest. Commander Sol is identified in the title and manuscript as the research collaborator.
